item.subject: science
item.stem:
Heena compares two planet cards: Planet P is nearer the Sun with a thin atmosphere; Planet Q is farther out but has a thick heat-trapping atmosphere. One card looks reddish and one looks bluish.

Which statement is the best scientific judgment?

options.A: Planet P must be hotter than Planet Q solely because it is closer; atmosphere never needs checking.
options.B: Greater distance generally means less solar energy and a colder trend, but Planet Q's thick atmosphere can trap heat and change that simple distance rule.
options.C: With similar atmospheres ignored, the farther planet is generally the hotter one.
options.D: A reddish planet is always hotter than a bluish one, so colour decides temperature.
